name: kainora-kids-web
description: KAINORA Kids - Premium Indonesian kids clothing e-commerce with Cloud AI

scripts.test:admin: node --test scripts/test-content-admin.mjs scripts/test-admin-server.mjs scripts/test-admin-local.mjs scripts/test-garment-rail.mjs scripts/test-product-pricing.mjs scripts/test-admin-upload-state.mjs
scripts.build: vite build && node scripts/build-journal.js && node scripts/build-products.mjs && node scripts/build-buyer-guides.mjs && node scripts/build-home.mjs && node scripts/hydrate-storefront.mjs
scripts.build:cloudflare: vite build --mode cloudflare && node scripts/build-journal.js && node scripts/build-products.mjs && node scripts/build-buyer-guides.mjs && node scripts/build-home.mjs && node scripts/hydrate-storefront.mjs && node scripts/check-cloudflare-assets.mjs
